body: Why is this needed to be removed?

Those should be necessary if `_validate_property()` is validating properties added by `_get_property_list()`. So I believe we cannot remove it from Skeleton and SkeletonProfile.

So it may be possible to remove it from AnimationMixer and StateMachine, but it needs to be tested.

> Does Object.get_property_list already call validate_property internally?

The built-in `get_property_list()` calls `_validate_property()` in it.

However, the `virtual _get_property_list() a.k.a. _get_property_listv()` is iterated after `get_property_list()`, which is not validated by `_validate_property()`. If you want to remove this iterating loop from all Nodes, you would need to add it after `_get_property_listv()` in `void Object::get_property_list()` in `object.cpp`, but I think it would reduce the performance of all Nodes for a few Nodes. So I believe we should not do that.

I don't fully understand `_get_property_list`, but we didn't call `_validate_property` inside it anywhere else.

Moreover, the 
 `_validate_property` of Skeleton3D should only be used in the editor (see also #105907)

In the meantime, I think this change should be included in #105907.

If there is a problem with this change, I assume there will be problems with the other parts changed in #105907 as well, so I suggest putting them in the same commit to make easier any follow up such as additional PR or urgent revert (of course, I hope that will not cause problems).

This PR is different from #105907. We still need to figure out whether the _validate_property() here are redundant.

#105907 just skips validating the properties that are editor-specific and do nothing when running games. it should be safe and I expect no one will rely on these property info in games.

`validate_property()` is only called for bound properties. If a property was added with `get_property_list()`, it will not be validated (and in most cases it doesn't need to, because `get_property_list()` is responsible for that). Both `get_property_list()` and `validate_property()` are multilevel methods, so you don't need to call base implementation.
Looks good to me. Will need squashing before merge.
